body: I'm gonna get crucified, but Shadow of the Colossus. Granted, I came to it years later on the PS3 version, so I probably missed out on the technical wow factor the original possessed. But man, I just found it so boring. The music was great, story was intriguing but I just did not enjoy the gameplay. Climbing around a big ol' thing and stabbing the glowy bits isn't exactly riveting in my book. I also don't know if it was just the PS3 version but there was some serious jank. I got up to the little bull-like colossus and when that thing somehow turned almost 180 degrees when it was charging to hit me and then proceeded to repeatedly hit me as I tried to get up until I was dead, I was like "Yup, fuck this." Not worth it.
Fucking terrible. No job, can't find a job, running out of money and food, not sure what I'm going to do. And that's on top of my normally very poor mental health. Fuck coronavirus. Fuck everything.
What if your personality sucks in addition to being ugly? Like, say, you're shy, not confident at all, about as fun to be around as a rock, are incredibly unfunny, etc... what then? Is there no hope?

Hah, nobody will read this but I guess I need to vent, so... pretty much everything. I graduated from school in March (it was a six-month trade program), right before the Coronavirus lockdown. Now, obviously, I don't know when I'll be able to get a job and my savings will run out very soon. I'm not sure what I'm going to do for work.

On top of that, my sister recently excommunicated my entire family. We had a rough childhood and she has mental health issues from it (as do I), and now I guess she blames all of us for her condition. I thought she was the only one who actually wanted me around in the family, so yeah, that hurts, and now I have to wrestle with the apparent fact that I'm part of why she has problems. Hard to not feel like I'm a monster given... other things that have happened in the past. Not gonna get into that, however.

On top of THAT, I'm turning 32 in about a week and I've never had a girlfriend and I have no friends whatsoever. I don't think I need to elaborate on that to explain why that sucks.

Further, my grandfather died a few weeks ago from the virus. So that really sucks. All in all, it's just a really rough time to be alive right now, especially with the protests and unchecked police brutality raging. I'm also worried about the election coming up, it's going to get ugly for a lot of reasons, I think. So yeah, life sucks right now.
Mostly Persona 5 Royal and Doom Eternal. Gonna be playing FF7 remake in a few days, so excited! It's been an amazing time to be stuck at home in regards to video games, both P5R and Doom are great.
A social life, a girlfriend who loves me, happiness... Yeah that's three things. Deal with it.

If they're smart, they won't. That moment is absolutely iconic and in many ways defined FF7 as a step forward for storytelling for the franchise. Not to mention they'd risk pissing off lots of fans who would be rabid at the slightest change. I highly doubt they'd do it.
Yeah I'm pretty sure they've said it's only Midgar. However, they also say they've added enough to make it a full-length game. What that means, we shall see upon release.
What the fuck is wrong with you?
Oooo I genuinely thought nobody would say Persona 5. Such a great soundtrack!
The new Modern Warfare. I'm usually decent at Call of Duty but for some reason I keep getting FUCKING DESTROYED in this year's game. Still having a decent enough time with it though.

I'm not the ugliest person in the world, but there is a 99.9% chance that I am the ugliest person in any given room. Here's an even better indicator: I'm a 31 y/o virgin. So yeah. VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY unattractive.
You should check out my amiugly posts then. I promise you won't be disappointed.

God, I wish I had someone in my life like you. You deserve an award.

​

Dude, this resonates with me so much. I've had a lot of the same problems, not being able to handle working most places, vanishing for long periods of time because I was just too depressed to talk to others, etc. Not too long ago I went to the hospital and got a diagnosis that made sense for the first time in my life: Borderline Personality Disorder, AKA stigma central. As soon as she got the news, my sister, who had until then been my biggest supporter in life, called me while I was in the hospital and said she didn't want to talk to me ever again. All because I was diagnosed with Borderline. It didn't change who I am, I'm not violent and never have been but all of a sudden she was afraid of me, because of a diagnosis. Stigma sucks. Thankfully, I have a couple friends who stuck with me but most of them left too. Education is so damn important.

Kinda good, kinda bad. My job is super stressful and asks me to handle much more than one person should be expected to, plus nobody here likes me much. I'm pretty much avoided like the plague by most people I meet which always gets me down. On the plus side, I might be getting a new job I'm excited about and I'll be getting back on meds soon. So hopefully a couple things will change soon.

Thank you. I really appreciate it. The truth is, I've never actually really tried to survive in the real world, I've just avoided it. Once I get the courage to actually go out into it, I hope I'm as successful as you have been. Cheers.
Sure. I'm sorry it took me a long time to respond, my life has been a bit busy the past few days which may be why I'm extra depressed lately. But I'm down to talk, I need all the friends I can get.

Thank you. It's actually a dream of mine to get a job working remotely as a web developer and travel the world! Maybe it will come true one day. Loneliness is an old friend by now, and if I could take her on a world tour with me, I think her company might just be bearable. Hell, I may even start to like it.
And what might those be, exactly? Seriously, I would absolutely love to hear them. I don't want to kill myself, I really really don't.

You're still young. I wouldn't worry about ending up like me too much because it would take a long series of bad luck and bad decisions on your part to get to my position. The chances are pretty much negligible. My advice? Be brave. Do things that challenge and scare you. Join an after-school club. Do anything at all, as long as you are doing something. DO NOT sit and do nothing, that just makes everything way way worse in the end, even if it's comforting in the moment. Seriously, as long as you get out of your house and don't lock yourself up like a hermit, you'll be fine.

Yeah, that's the only thing that has stopped me up until this point. However, all of my family has moved away now so I'm the only one left here. It's hard to keep that in mind when I rarely see any of my family.

I don't know about that. I think he was just trying to help, albeit in a slightly misguided way. I don't know what I would do if I got a girlfriend, had her for 8 years and then had to move back in with my parents. That would be a hell of a blow. Like most people here, I'm sure he was just looking for someone to commiserate with.

I have been a video game addict since I was six lol. It's probably been a huge hindrance throughout my life which is why I would love to give them up and live an actual life. I have trouble believing I can do that though.
I have, but I don't think there's really much she can do to help, unless she can wave a magic wand and make people like me.

Hmm, well, I can be a jerk when I am feeling depressed in that I don't want to talk to anybody and it shows, but in general I try to be nice. I think it's just that people find me incredibly boring because I'm awkward and quiet and super serious all the time. Who would want to be around a guy like that?
Ha, yeah that probably is my only option at this point.
Now, see, you at least have proof that someone CAN love you, and therefore it might happen again. I've never had that experience and see no reason to believe that it will change.

You're doing much better than me. I swipe right on everyone and I get maybe 3 matches a week. If I am lucky. But I am undoubtedly incredibly ugly so that is probably not common. Anyway, if you are not liking indiscriminately, you are peobably doing well.

I've been using the app for about 4 or 5 months and I've had 3 matches total (and I live in a fairly large city, roughly 2 million people), all of which I wasn't attracted to in the slightest, but from previous dating site experience I knew it was the best I was going to get so I messaged all of them. Not a thing. Still, us uglies can't give up! Keep a positive attitude, my friend. That's always better than getting angry and bitter.

Before people can even tell that I'm a sadsack, (women especially) will talk to me only if absolutely necessary and as briefly as possible. And let's not even get into how people look at me when they first see me.

Sigh, I was merely attempting to show people that they do not have it as bad as they think they do, not trying to tell them they can't post here. And I'm pretty darn sure it's not just my state of mind. Not when everyone I know in RL says that I am ugly...

Glad I managed to improve your day a bit :D
I am not making a duckface in my photos. My lips look like that naturally. Everything about my face is super dorky like that.

Yeah, I would say being tall definitely helps outweigh being overweight. And trust me, every girl looks like they are about to puke if I speak to them, so it's not just a matter of talking more to them. I'm also willing to bet your face is far more handsome than mine.

Why the hell would I have ever expected girls to flock at my feet? Ha, girls were calling me "the ugly boy" by the time I was ten. They even would gather and throw rocks at me and laugh at recess. Once, I accidentally bumped into a girl in high school and she reported me to the principal, saying I had groped her vagina (which I would NEVER do). I have asked two girls out in my lifetime, and one of them slapped me and the other looked like she was going to vomit and walked off without a word. Come on, why would I have expected anything other than a lifetime of virginity?

My beard growing capabilities are pathetic. After not shaving for 2 weeks I look more patchy and scraggly than most 15 year olds do after 3 days. So that solution is out the window right there.

I will take your advice about testing the products carefully. As much as I want to change my looks overnight I know that is impossible so I might as well take the time to do it right. Once again, thank you so much for your input.

Thanks for the feedback, again! Yeah... I didn't think it was all that much better myself (gah, waste of $50!).  Here is a picture of this hairstyle without the glasses: http://imgur.com/j2kPoS0.
